description: Telecommunications Spend and Demand Report in Victoria, 2012 is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Jobs, Skills, Industry and Regions. The Victorian Government commissioned Deloitte Access Economics to develop a model of Victoria’s telecommunications market to provide a tool for government and market participants to analyse trends, identify unmet demand and to assist in planning for the future. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Jobs, Skills, Industry and Regions. Its tags are Telecommunications, coverage, demand, recruitment, report. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2015-12-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
